The boundary conditions (BC) on ∂ Ω are usually of Dirichlet type ( D ), when f is known, or Neumann ( N ), when ∂f/∂⃗n is known ( ⃗n normal to ∂ Ω ), or a combination of the two. When Ω is large or the need for accuracy is high, N becomes rapidly very large ( N ≫ 10 6 ) and the computer solving and the numerical storing of the inverse matrix A − 1 , solution of Eq. 2, can become problematic.
